correctness.rationale: For any nonempty automaton size n>=2 and h in [1,n-1], H(A) acts equivariantly, reducing rank by a factor s to an aperiodic quotient of size m. On the quotient the d=gcd(m,h) residue classes cannot merge, proving rank>=d. The exact inverse-interval identity under conjugate partial jumps collapses each residue class, proving rank<=d. Cases d=m and m=1 are included. The standalone BFS independently checked all 16,388 small parameter instances, with 83,324 constructive witnesses, but the proof establishes the infinite quantifiers.

value.rationale: This is a complete exact classification of an intrinsic automaton invariant over infinitely many sizes, all nonzero jumps and all active patterns, including empty/full and every nonprimitive case. The product of the pattern stabilizer size and gcd after quotient identifies two genuinely interacting structural obstructions. Both the exact invariant and its synchronizability corollary are natural; no novel shortest-word length is claimed.
